description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing Device entities, providing methods for common queries like finding devices by user, ID, protocol, status, and performing a search based on device attributes.

classes.name: DeviceRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for Device entity, providing various methods to query devices based on user, ID, protocol, status, and perform full-text search.

methods.name: findByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves a page of devices associated with a specific user ID.

methods.name: findByIdAndUserId
methods.description: Finds a device by its ID and associated user ID.

methods.name: searchDevices
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive search for devices matching the search term in name, IP address, or protocol for a specific user.

methods.name: findByProtocolAndUserId
methods.description: Finds all devices matching a specific protocol for a user.

methods.name: findByStatusAndUserId
methods.description: Finds all devices with a specific status for a user.

methods.name: countDevicesByProtocol
methods.description: Counts the number of devices per protocol for a given user.

calls: @Query(...) Page<Device> searchDevices(@Param("userId") String userId, @Param("searchTerm") String searchTerm, Pageable pageable)
@Query("SELECT d.protocol, COUNT(d) FROM Device d WHERE d.userId = :userId GROUP BY d.protocol") List<Object[]> countDevicesByProtocol(@Param("userId") String userId)
